OlloBot Targets Emotional Connection in Home Robotics Following IFA Berlin Success

01 Nov 2026, 11:58 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Business Desk · Source: www.prnewswire.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysAI companion brand OlloBot has signaled a strategic shift in the consumer robotics market, emphasizing emotional engagement over traditional task-oriented automation. Following its European debut at IFA Berlin 2026, the company is preparing to expand its portfolio at the upcoming CES 2027 in Las Vegas.

Expanding the Role of Home Robotics

AI companion brand OlloBot has signaled a strategic shift in the consumer robotics market, emphasizing emotional engagement over traditional task-oriented automation. Following its European debut at IFA Berlin 2026, the company is preparing to expand its portfolio at the upcoming CES 2027 in Las Vegas.

At IFA Berlin, the company’s flagship device, the OlloNi SS1, was recognized as an Honoree in the Best in Home & Entertainment category of the IFA Innovation Awards. The device utilizes the company's proprietary 'EmpathCore' emotional engine and 'Affinilog' interaction system, designed to facilitate communication through touch, sound, and non-verbal cues.

Shifting Market Trends

The move aligns with findings from IDC’s 'Top 10 Trends in China's Robotics and Embodied Intelligence Market for 2026.' The report suggests a transition in the industry where educational and companion robots are evolving into 'all-age home intelligent terminals.' Key aspects of this shift include:

  • A movement toward long-term companionship and contextual understanding.
  • A focus on ongoing content services rather than singular task execution.
  • The prioritization of lasting relationships between the user and the device.

Future Developments

OlloBot, a subsidiary of BizConf Technology Co., Ltd., is positioning its 'Cyber Pet' concept as an alternative to typical humanoid robots. According to founder Lyn Fang, the design philosophy focuses on 'restraint,' aiming to create devices that learn when to engage and when to remain passive, rather than demanding constant user attention.

Looking toward the CES 2027 exhibition, the company has announced plans to introduce two additional robots: a desktop lamp-form model and the next-generation OlloBot Gen 2. The brand also intends to display merchandise and peripheral products related to its 'OlloVerse' digital ecosystem.

Verification and Further Information

Consumers and industry observers can monitor further announcements and technical specifications through the official company channels. As these products move toward commercialization, interested parties are encouraged to verify product availability and regional release timelines via:

  • Official website: ollobot.com
  • Social media updates via the brand's verified YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram accounts.

While the company has reported positive feedback from exhibition attendees, potential users should note that the efficacy of 'emotional companionship' remains subjective and dependent on individual user experience.
